metadata.description: Claude plugins from Red Center Studio: free website checks, small business websites built by an agent, and a read-only audit of no-code apps.

plugins.name: website-checks
plugins.description: Free website checks as MCP tools, no key: GEO audit (AI search readiness), single point of failure DNS scan, Bubble error decoder.

plugins.name: webdesk
plugins.description: Build a complete one-page small business website from a short brief and get back a ZIP the business owns. Prepaid credits, from $29 USD per website.

plugins.name: nocode-migration-audit
plugins.description: Read-only audit of a no-code app before porting it to code. Writes a neutral app spec and a plain-language report. Bubble is supported today.
